title: use device features
rule: Populate the field from phone features when they apply (camera, GPS, voice, contacts).

citation.source: NN/g — A Checklist for Designing Mobile Input Fields

pass_when: Where camera, GPS, voice, or contacts can supply the value, that path is offered.
overview: Offer camera, GPS, voice, or contacts to populate fields when they apply.
apply_when: Mobile fields whose value can come from device capture features.
not_when: Desktop contexts without those device capture capabilities.
agent_hint: Offer camera, GPS, voice, or contacts paths when they can supply the value.
description: Populate the field from phone features when they apply — camera, GPS, voice, contacts. Pass where those features can supply the value and that path is offered; fail when applicable device capture is typing-only. Device paths reduce typing burden on mobile without inventing features the platform lacks or forcing capture where it does not apply.
